messages:
sara-sales: Quick heads up 1 FinTrust pre-sales: their security team flagged our KMS approach as a blocker for the POC. They want BYOK with HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 L3) or an approved compensating-controls plan.
jon-se: Do they explicitly require on-prem HSM or just HSM-backed cloud KMS (CloudHSM, HSM import)? Need the exact ask.
marta: From the questionnaire: they marked SIG/CAIQ controls around key custody (s7.6) and key management (s10.2) as non-compliant. Their checklist calls out "HSM-backed key material required" for import use. For a POC we could offer a scoped exception with controls.
kevin-legal: We cant grant open-ended exceptions. Legal will require a timeboxed addendum for the POC, clearly-liable scope, audit rights, and an explicit residual risk acceptance. Also need confirmation that no plaintext key material will leave customer control.
security-bot: Automated assessment: "KMS/HSM: Mismatch with customer requirement. Risk HIGH. Recommend: customer-owned keys, cross-account logging, immutable audit, restricted admin roles." Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/1802345678
marta: Draft compensating controls for a 90-day POC: 1) Customer supplies key material via supported import to their KMS or uses their CloudHSM. 2) Cross-account CloudTrail -> dedicated S3 with object lock + replication to customer's audit account. 3) Lambda alerts on AdminKey / GenerateDataKey events to both customer and us. 4) Enforce MFA + RBAC for key admins, enforced rotation schedule, and deny export of plaintext. 5) Limit data scope: tokenization of sensitive fields, retention <= 7 days for POC. 6) Pre-approved rollback and revocation playbook.
jon-se: Engineering questions: can we wire cross-account CloudTrail and alerting within 1-2 days for a POC? Also need a succinct checklist we can send to the customer to sign.
marta: Yes. We have a template S3 bucket policy and a CloudFormation snippet to set up CloudTrail->S3 with object lock. Example policy (trimmed):
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Sid":"AllowCloudTrailPut",
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},
    "Action":"s3:PutObject",
    "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc-logs/*"
  }]
}
```
marta: We'll also require: non-export of raw key bytes to our infra, attestations that key material is HSM-backed, and a short onboarding checklist for SEs.
sara-sales: FinTrust prefers 90 days. They're OK with a timeboxed waiver if controls are in writing and they can audit.
kevin-legal: I'll draft a one-page POC addendum: "Limited BYOK/HSM Waiver (90 days)" with listed compensating controls, audit rights, and liability cap scoped to the POC. Will include termination and auto-expiry clauses.
jon-se: Action items: - sara-sales: confirm FinTrust KMS vendor + get signature on addendum. - marta: implement cross-account logging + alert lambda, publish SE checklist. - kevin-legal: post draft addendum for security review. - jon-se: update vendor-risk tracker + mark as "pending controls" with target review date.
sara-sales: I'll reach out to FinTrust now and attach the checklist. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
marta: Note: scope exception to this single POC only, auto-expire at 90 days unless extended by documented renewal with security and legal sign-off.
kevin-legal: Draft will be posted here when ready for review. :memo:
jon-se: Sounds good. Once signed, I'll move it to "approved-with-controls" in the tracker. :white_check_mark:
